title: Phronix: The Capability-Centric Learning Paradigm for Agents
description:
arXiv:2610.31789v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Scientific computing increasingly relies on large language model-based agents for performance engineering tasks such as instrumentation, analysis, and workflow porting. However, agent effectiveness depends heavily on the surrounding harness, which typically relies on manually written skills and curated memory.
